items.title: Is FactSet’s Expanded Credit Facilities Reshaping the Investment Case For FactSet Research Systems (FDS)?
items.summary: FactSet Research Systems recently amended its senior unsecured credit facilities, extending its US$375,000,000 term loan to August 28, 2029 and enlarging its revolving credit line from US$1.00 billion to US$1.50 billion with a new maturity of August 28, 2031. By removing amortization on the term loan and eliminating certain credit spread adjustments, the revised agreement meaningfully increases FactSet’s financial flexibility and access to liquidity for future corporate needs.
